messages:
elena.sre: paging noise -> DeltaCorp (enterprise VPC, dedicated pool) reporting no tenant metrics in console, traces not showing for any requests since ~09:12 UTC. alert: tenant_metrics_absent[delta] triggered. :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE (sev-2) created for tenant delta: missing-metrics. Paging: elena.sre (oncall), samir.eng (eng-oncall), taylor.pdx (customer-sre). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1905006789
samir.eng: seeing same in Grafana — per-tenant metrics panel for delta is flat. cluster-level metrics ok. Looks like forwarder is dropping events for that tenant. quick check: are logs arriving to the forwarder?
elena.sre: ran quick check on forwarder pod in us-west-2 dedicated pool: `kubectl logs forwarder-delta-0 -n redwood-obsv | tail -n 100` shows repeated auth errors: "403: tenant not authorized to write". snippet: ```2026-03-14T09:11:57Z ERROR auth.go:87 tenant=delta token=expired```
ops_maya: hmm we rotated the tenant ephemeral token hour ago for the dedicated pool rotation job. Could be the new token not propagated to the VPC forwarder. Delta is using our forwarder-agent in their VPC via an SSM-backed secret.
taylor.pdx: confirmed customer impact: Delta's internal dashboards show missing latency and errors. They're noticing degraded alerting and aren't able to correlate traffic spikes. Customer-facing contact (acct-john) notified.
acct-john: I called Delta account team, they confirmed they started seeing gaps at 09:10 UTC and are fairly concerned because this hits their SLIs. They've requested ETA and mitigation steps. Keeping them updated every 15m.
samir.eng: quick mitigation options: 1) push previous token back to forwarder (rollback secret); 2) enable proxy fallback to use central forwarder (read-only) so metrics flow but at lower throughput; 3) ask Delta to rotate tenant token from their side (not ideal). leaning to rollback secret to previous valid token temporarily.
netops-ryan: if we push previous token need to ensure it isn't compromised. quick verification: previous token last used at 08:58 UTC and only by our rotation job. rollback ok for emergency but we'll schedule audit.
elena.sre: let's do rollback. samir, can you coordinate with ops_maya to update SSM secret in Delta VPC? I'll start comms to Delta with an ETA of 10 minutes. (reacted :thumbsup:)
samir.eng: on it. running command to update secret: ```aws ssm put-parameter --name "/delta/forwarder/token" --value "<previous-token>" --type SecureString --overwrite``` will patch agent via manager. doing now.
ops_maya: applied change, restarted forwarder pod (rolling restart). logs now show successful auth. `kubectl logs forwarder-delta-0 -n redwood-obsv | tail -n 50` shows: `INFO auth.go:120 tenant=delta token=validated`
taylor.pdx: Grafana: per-tenant metrics panel for delta starting to show spikes again at 09:18 UTC. traces still not present, likely needs KV cache warmth / span replay.
elena.sre: good. bringing traces back may need the trace-forwarder replay job. We don't persist spans in central storage by default; however we do buffer last 30m of spans in the VPC forwarder local cache. If cache purged during restart we might lose in-flight traces.
samir.eng: starting a targeted trace playback from the forwarder cache to central collector: `redwood-obsv replay --tenant delta --source forwarder-delta-0 --window 15m` output: ```replay: 1200 spans queued, 0 errors, throughput 300/s```
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated auth token issue, partial recovery (metrics returning). continuing trace replay. severity moving to progressive-monitoring.
taylor.pdx: customer notified: told them metrics are returning and we're replaying traces; asked them to verify dashboards in ~10m. They're appreciative but want root cause writeup and timeline.
acct-john: Delta asked whether this could have been prevented. I'll flag for post-incident review and connect them to platform for the rotation policy explanation.
netops-ryan: root cause hypothesis: rotation job generated new token but failed to update SSM parameter in their VPC due to a transient IAM permission denial (role assumption failed). We'll capture IAM CloudTrail entries for the rotation window and check rotation service logs.
elena.sre: action items captured: 1) samir/ops_maya — run IAM audit and confirm rotation job failure mode (ETA 2h). 2) netops-ryan — add retry + alert on rotation failures (ETA 3d). 3) platform — consider grace window where previous token remains valid for 15m post-rotation (design doc). 4) eng-sre team — produce customer timeline and RCA for Delta (ETA 6h).
samir.eng: saving archive logs and rotation job traces to /incidents/1905006789/artifacts. Also tagging Delta tenant in incident record.
elena.sre: handing off to taylor for monitoring and customer comms. I'm going offline for 20m to eat; leave a note in thread if anything regresses.
taylor.pdx: taking over. will post status every 10 minutes. current status: metrics recovered, traces replaying (expected full reconciliation by 09:28 UTC).
oncall-bot: INCIDENT STATUS CHANGE: assigned -> monitoring. last update 09:20 UTC.
acct-john: confirmed Delta saw metrics populate. they're satisfied with mitigation but want RCA and evidence that token rotation will be fixed. I'll coordinate followups.
taylor.pdx: note for postmortem: include per-tenant observability gap checklist (token propagation, forwarder cache durability, rotation retry policy). tagging eng-sre for follow-up.
elena.sre: closing notes: incident resolved for customer impact; will transition to post-incident doc. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
samir.eng: export timeline for PMR and include a snippet of the auth error and subsequent successful auth logs.
netops-ryan: filing infra ticket INFRA-1229 to add rotation monitoring and apply least-privilege fix for rotation role.
taylor.pdx: handoff complete. leaving monitoring on for 1h. will escalate if we see any regression.
acct-john: adding follow-up meeting with Delta for 2026-03-14 15:00 UTC to review RCA and mitigation plan.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (customer-impact mitigated) at 09:25 UTC. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1905006789/close
elena.sre: thanks team. great quick coordination.
samir.eng: +1
